architectural_notes: Infra: exercised by the Alembic up migration on the paired branch, verified via the repository (app/repositories, the only ORM-touching layer). The delimiter-parse backfill (segment 2 -> batch_number, segment 3 -> serial_number) is pure transformation logic owned by app/services and invoked inside the migration transaction so add+backfill is atomic; the stock entity gains the two nullable columns in app/models/stock.py. Realizes PI1 (migration_reversible) and NFR-F6-data-survival by confirming a conforming row backfills while quantity and location stay intact.
given: a sprint-1 stock row whose inventory_code is a full location-batch-serial code (for example "A12-B7-S001")
when: the up migration runs and backfills the new columns by splitting the code on the hyphen delimiter
then: that row's batch_number equals the second segment and serial_number equals the third segment, and the row remains retrievable with its quantity and location intact
